record.description_evidence:
AI Writer turns a short request into a ready text in seconds: a business letter, a reply to a customer, a post, a report, a greeting or a story. Describe what you need — the AI writes it for you.

WHAT YOU CAN WRITE
• Business letters and emails
• Replies to inquiries and complaints
• Memos and explanatory notes
• News and social media posts
• Event scripts and lesson plans
• Answers to questions
• Reports and essays
• Greetings and wishes
• Product descriptions
• Stories and poems

IMPROVE YOUR OWN TEXT
Paste a draft and switch to "Improve my text": the AI fixes the wording, structure and tone while keeping your meaning.

LENGTH AND STYLE
Choose short, medium or long, and the style: business, simple, warm, academic or lively. Or leave it on Auto.

EDIT IN ONE TAP
Not quite right? Tap Another version, Continue, Shorter, More detailed, Simpler or More formal — or type what to change in your own words.

HANDY TOOLS
• Example requests to start in one tap
• Voice input
• Open .txt, .docx, .pdf and .rtf files
• Copy and share in one tap
• History of all your texts
• Texts in 100+ languages
• No sign-up

FREE AND PRO
The app is free with ads: requests up to 3,000 characters. PRO removes ads and gives requests up to 35,000 characters, 1,000,000 characters per month and priority processing.

AI-generated texts can contain mistakes. Always check the result before you send or publish it.

Transform your story ideas into complete novels with NovelWriter, the revolutionary AI-powered writing companion that brings your creative vision to life. Whether you are an aspiring author, creative writer, or storytelling enthusiast, NovelWriter makes novel creation effortless and enjoyable.

Instant Novel Generation
Turn your plot ideas into fully written novels in minutes. Simply describe your story, characters, and preferred writing style, and watch as our advanced on-device AI brings your narrative to life chapter by chapter. No waiting, no writer's block—just pure creative output.

Powerful AI Features
• Generate compelling story titles that capture your novel's essence
• Create detailed chapter plots automatically based on your story concept
• Write unlimited chapters in any author's style—from Shakespeare to Austen to modern bestsellers
• All processing happens locally on your device for maximum privacy and speed

Complete Creative Control
You remain the author. Customize every aspect of your novel including writing style, character descriptions, chapter count, and word count ranges. Our AI adapts to your vision, creating content that matches your creative direction perfectly.

Professional PDF Output
Every novel includes a beautiful title page and professionally formatted chapters. Export high-quality PDFs ready to share, publish, or keep in your personal library. Your novels look professional from page one.

Privacy First Design
Your stories remain completely private. All AI generation happens on your device using Apple Intelligence—no internet connection required, no data sent to external servers. Your creative work stays yours.

Intuitive Writing Experience
Our streamlined interface makes novel creation simple. Fill in your story details, generate chapters with one tap, and preview your work in real-time. The app guides you through each step, making professional novel creation accessible to everyone.

Try Before You Buy
Start with 5 free novels to experience the full power of AI-assisted writing. Once you are ready, unlock unlimited novel generation with a single affordable purchase—no subscription required.

Key Features
• On-device AI powered by Apple Intelligence
• Generate novels in any writing style
• Automatic chapter plot generation
• AI-generated story titles
• Customizable chapter counts and word ranges
• Beautiful PDF export with title pages
• Save and organize your novel library
• Share your creations instantly
• Works completely offline
• One-time purchase, unlimited use

Perfect For
• Creative writers exploring new story ideas
• Authors overcoming writer's block

• Storytellers who want to see their ideas fully realized
• Anyone who has dreamed of writing a novel

NovelWriter democratizes novel creation, making it possible for anyone to become a published author. Whether you write for fun, education, or professional aspirations, our AI-powered platform provides the tools you need to transform imagination into literature.

Download NovelWriter today and start your journey from idea to finished novel. Your next masterpiece is just a few taps away.

record.description_evidence:
Struggling to compose emails and write replies to the messages in your inbox? Xemail is here to help you write emails 10 times faster!
 
Xemail is a smart AI email writer and generator that helps you write emails and letters, and generate replies in seconds. As a professional AI email writing assistant powered by ChatGPT API and GPT-4, Xemail leverages the latest artificial intelligence technology to craft professional, articulate, and engaging emails. Whether you're creating business emails, drafting a cover letter, or writing a WhatsApp reply, Xemail is your go-to solution.
 
Key Features of Xemail:
 
• Time-saving: Write an email in seconds and say goodbye to spending hours making a professional email. Xemail is quick, efficient, and hassle-free.
• Effortless drafting: Input your basic ideas, and let Xemail articulate them into well-structured emails.
• Advanced AI tool for email writing: Harness the power of AI to write emails. From formal business emails to friendly updates, Xemail adapts to your needs.
• Smart suggestions: Get suggestions for effective phrasing and tone, making your emails impactful and engaging.
• Personalized emails: Customizable templates cater to various themes - business, education, personal, and more. Get email examples and samples for job applications, reminders, out-of-office replies, introductions, promotions, and sales.
• Multiple language support: Our AI supports more than 50 languages, including Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Italian, Dutch, Hindi, and Portuguese.
 
Xemail is the AI email generator and writing helper in your pocket for every occasion. With just a few clicks, you can create emails tailored to your specific context and audience. Also, you can learn how to write emails to improve your email writing skills. 
 
Business
 
We help you generate professional emails that reflect your brand's voice and ethos, ensuring effective communication with clients and colleagues. Whether crafting a follow-up email after receiving no response, composing compelling marketing emails, or initiating cold emails, Xemail can help you write them in seconds. It also provides a wealth of professional business email examples and samples to guide you. 
 
Job 
 
Need to send a resignation letter or follow up after an interview? Xemail has you covered. Our AI also assists in drafting emails for applying for a job, creating compelling cover letters and even generating personalized letters of recommendation. 
 
Personal Use
 
Our AI helps you create heartfelt personal emails, Whether you're expressing gratitude with a thank-you letter or conveying sincere sentiments in an apology email. Also, Xemail AI can help you compose messages and generate responses.
 
Download Xemail now on Apple Store and experience the future of email composition. Start using Xemail with a free trial.

Contact: support@xemail.ai
Terms: https://www.xemail.ai/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://www.xemail.ai/privacy.html

INFORMATION ON USING THE APP AND REGARDING SUBSCRIPTION
Xemail is free to download and use. However, to unlock the full range of features, you can choose from various subscription plans. When you opt for a subscription, the price is determined based on your country and displayed within the app. If you wish to continue your subscription, it will automatically renew for the originally chosen duration, charging your selected payment method, unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current term expires. You also have the option to disable the auto-renewal feature in your App Store account settings.
